original_benchmark.notes: 200 test episodes asked at k = 1..6 (apparatus S11 only at k = 3..6). Upstream evaluates VLMs directly with run.py --paper-settings (OpenRouter chat completions, recorded per-question settings in inference/profiles.json, at most one answer-completion request). Train/validation splits exist only for the fine-tuning baselines and are not adapted.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a 118-task subset: one question per (apparatus, k), selected deterministically (adapter.py, PARITY_SEED). Parity results pending.
